name: Apache — Suspicious POST to Server-Side Script Path
xql_query:
datamodel dataset = apache_httpd_raw
| alter method = xdm.network.http.method,
        status = to_integer(xdm.network.http.response_code),
        url = xdm.network.http.url,
        ua = xdm.source.user_agent
| filter method = "POST" and status in (200, 201, 302)
| filter url contains "/uploads/" and (url contains ".php" or url contains ".jsp" or url contains ".aspx")
       or url contains "shell.php"
       or url contains "cmd.php"
       or url contains "c99.php"
       or url contains "r57.php"
       or url contains "webshell"
       or url contains ".php?cmd="
       or url contains "eval("
| bin _time span = 30m
| comp count() as posts,
       count_distinct(url) as distinct_paths,
       values(url) as posted_paths,
       values(ua) as user_agents,
       values(status) as response_codes,
       values(xdm.target.ipv4) as tgt_ips
       by xdm.source.ipv4, _time
| filter posts >= 3 and distinct_paths >= 2
| fields xdm.source.ipv4, tgt_ips, posted_paths, user_agents, response_codes
description: Apache HTTP POST with 200/201/302 response to a path containing 'upload', 'shell', 'cmd', '.php?cmd', '/admin', or 'eval' — possible web shell installation.
alert_name: Apache — Suspicious POST to Server-Side Script Path
alert_description:
What fired: Apache HTTP POST with 200/201/302 response to a path containing 'upload', 'shell', 'cmd', '.php?cmd', '/admin', or 'eval' — possible web shell installation.

Why it matters: an actor may be gaining an initial foothold (phishing, exploit, or valid accounts). Assessed severity: Medium.

MITRE ATT&CK: T1190 - Exploit Public-Facing Application (TA0001 - Initial Access); T1505.003 - Server Software Component: Web Shell (TA0003 - Persistence).

Investigate:
  - Identify the entry vector, the targeted user/asset, and the source.
  - Check for successful access and any follow-on execution or persistence from the same actor.
  - Pivot on the alert's key entity (xdm.source.ipv4) to related activity in the same window.
  - Confirm the activity is not expected/authorized for the involved entity before escalating.

TA0003 - Persistence: T1505.003 - Server Software Component: Web Shell
